scope.summary: Enforce cloud projection, consent, and authority boundaries for cloud lanes.
forbidden_paths: raw workspace cloud upload without ProjectionPlan
cloud output becoming authoritative without promotion
npm/JavaScript proof targets for this WP
app/src-tauri launch or IPC authority for this WP
proof commands that pass with zero matching tests
acceptance_criteria: Cloud lane launch fails closed without required ProjectionPlan/ConsentReceipt.
Cloud lane messages carry redaction/projection metadata.
Cloud outputs are advisory until explicit promotion.

Cloud lane launch MUST reject missing, expired, mismatched, or revoked ConsentReceipts; receipts MUST bind to ProjectionPlan hash, run_id, lane_id, model_session_id, provider, scope, retention, and fan-out targets. Revocation MUST cancel pending covered jobs and mark affected lanes blocked/cancelled with CX-MM-007 plus typed consent_status metadata.
Cloud projection and consent records include stable ids, hashes, source artifact refs, redaction policy, retention/export posture, provider profile, fan-out disclosure, and replay-safe summaries.
Cloud lane denied/missing consent paths emit CX-MM-007 plus Flight Recorder/EventLedger evidence and do not launch provider calls or create partial authority state.
Cloud tool/sampling requests follow explicit consent/control and result-visibility boundaries; provider tool descriptions are not trusted as authority.
Cloud consent/projection proof MUST cover missing, expired, mismatched, and revoked consent receipts, and must cancel or block pending covered jobs with typed durable status.
ProjectionPlan and ConsentReceipt rows MUST link to run_id, lane_id, model_session_id, provider_kind, scope hash, payload/artifact refs, EventLedger event id, and UserManual behavior id.

After implementation and before READY_FOR_VALIDATION, this MT MUST receive post-implementation adversarial review against the actual diff. Findings must be fixed or converted into explicit lifecycle blocker/missing_resource/proof_status state; the implementer may not self-certify COMPLETED.
scope.risk_if_missed: Cloud models can silently receive or author workspace state outside Handshake policy.

implementation_notes: Cloud lane launch must fail closed with CX-MM-007 when required ProjectionPlan or ConsentReceipt is missing.
Consent receipt, cloud escalation request, and projection-plan evidence must preserve stable ids, hashes, manifest refs, retention, and replay/export semantics from the folded cloud-consent stub.
Cloud lane messages must carry projection/redaction metadata and may not become authoritative until explicitly promoted.
Provider-specific consent UI flows are out of scope; shared backend artifact/manifest semantics are in scope.
Flight Recorder/EventLedger events must link cloud request, consent/projection artifact refs, lane_id, run_id, session/model_session_id, and outcome.
MCP consent/tool-safety guidance translates to Handshake capability check -> consent/projection -> Flight Recorder/EventLedger -> execution -> result capture.
Cloud outputs are advisory artifacts until a typed promotion record exists, even if the provider response is structured or high confidence.
Do not store raw secrets, unredacted workspace data, or full cloud prompts in Flight Recorder payloads; store manifest/artifact refs and redacted summaries.
Use Flight Recorder/EventLedger payloads as bounded events plus artifact refs; do not put unbounded model output, raw secrets, or prompt-only state in event payloads.

If this MT changes any product behavior, storage/event contract, command, IPC/API path, diagnostic surface, model lane, or navigation path, update the in-product UserManual in the same implementation change per HBR-MAN-004.

Product implementation for this MT must be Rust-only: Rust backend plus Rust native egui/Argus surfaces where UI is touched. Legacy app/src, app/src-tauri, React, Tauri/WebView, TypeScript, JavaScript, docs/model-manual, and npm proof targets are reference-only or forbidden and MUST NOT satisfy implementation/proof authority.

Proof commands must name exact Rust test targets or exact test names. Zero matching tests is a hard failure. Deterministic provider fakes are allowed for cloud/local model calls, but PostgreSQL/EventLedger/ArtifactStore/CRDT/UserManual/Argus authority must touch real Handshake-owned Rust resources or an explicit real PostgreSQL URL.
Each behavior-changing MT must include same-change UserManual coverage for the changed behavior; MT-011 audits coverage and cannot substitute for same-change HBR-MAN-004 proof.

This pre-implementation contract review does not replace post-implementation review. After coding, run adversarial review against the actual diff through the listed lenses and update MT status signaling before handoff.
